style.styleTitle: Personalised Brass Globe Christmas Decoration by Oakdene
style.toneOfVoice: Add something truly special to your festive décor with this magical solid brass family Christmas tree decoration — a stylish twist (literally!) on traditional ornaments. Featuring a beautiful metallic sheen and a personalised touch, this unique piece brings a modern, golden glow to your Christmas tree. Please note: this decoration arrives flat. Simply follow the easy steps in the instructions provided to gently twist it into shape. Each piece is precision-cut from 0.9mm solid brass using our specialist machine, then printed directly onto the metal using our state-of-the-art printer — ensuring a crisp, high-quality, and lasting finish. Flat size measures approximately W9cm x H9cm. Size : ONE.
